en_title: Naoki Hamaguchi Doubles Down on Connecting All Final Fantasy VII Spinoffs Into Revelation’s Ending
subtitle: 外传角色齐聚
opus_summary: 《Final Fantasy VII Revelation》导演滨口直树确认，结局将考虑《Advent Children》《Dirge of Cerberus》《Crisis Core》等外传，并称玩家最终会迎来一个「单一结局」。

quality_review.review_notes: Independent bilingual self-review completed for coverage, attribution, uncertainty, numbers, dates, currency, units, names, media, and natural Chinese news style.

paragraphs.en: Final Fantasy VII Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi opened up on the game’s connection to the Advent Children film, saying that more than one of FF7’s spin-offs are going to tie into the game’s ending.
paragraphs.cn: 《Final Fantasy VII Revelation》导演滨口直树谈及游戏与电影《Advent Children》的联系，称不止一款FF7外传会与游戏结局产生关联。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with YouTuber Ashif’s Release Notes at Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival Berlin 2026, Naoki revealed that he’s well aware of the fan theories surrounding the next game in the Remake trilogy, particularly where ties to other properties in the FF7 universe are concerned.
paragraphs.cn: 在2026年柏林Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival期间接受油管主Ashif的Release Notes采访时，滨口透露，他十分了解粉丝围绕Remake三部曲下一作提出的理论，尤其是该作与FF7宇宙其他作品之间的联系。

paragraphs.en: He assured Ashif that he’s carefully considering all of these titles, specifically mentioning Dirge of Cerberus , Crisis Core, and of course, the Advent Children movie.
paragraphs.cn: 他向Ashif保证，自己正认真考虑所有这些作品，特别点名提到Dirge of Cerberus、Crisis Core，以及当然还有电影《Advent Children》。

paragraphs.en: "I see a great deal of that discussion. I've seen a lot of people discussing and speculating off the back of interviews with myself and with Kitase-san, 'Is the ending of this going to connect to Advent Children?'” he began.
paragraphs.cn: 「我看到了大量相关讨论。很多人都在根据我和Kitase先生接受的采访展开讨论与猜测：‘这部作品的结局会与《Advent Children》产生联系吗？’」他开头说道。

paragraphs.en: “But it's not a question. I don't want to sit here and say it connects to this, it connects to that. But obviously, there are a lot of other titles within the VII universe. So, we're talking about Advent Children, we're talking about Dirge of Cerberus, Crisis Core . And we want to bring all of those in and make sure we're not leaving those out.
paragraphs.cn: 「但这不是一个问题。我不想坐在这里说它会与这个产生联系、与那个产生联系。不过，VII宇宙中显然还有许多其他作品。因此，我们会讨论《Advent Children》、Dirge of Cerberus、Crisis Core。我们希望把它们全部纳入其中，确保不会遗漏任何一部。」

paragraphs.en: “And then on top of that, once we have all of those in place, we're looking towards the ending. And then the question is, what kind of ending are we going to head for in Revelation that still has those ties? And I think that's something that I really hope players will look forward to finding out."
paragraphs.cn: 「然后，在把这些全部安排好之后，我们会着眼于结局。接下来问题是，在Revelation中我们要走向怎样的结局，同时保留这些联系？我认为，这是我真心希望玩家期待揭晓的事情。」

paragraphs.en: While Hamaguchi was careful not to say anything that would outright spoil things, his answer has certainly fueled an animated debate within the community, especially following similar comments previously made by other devs working on the Remake trilogy.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然滨口谨慎避免直接剧透，但他的回答显然在社区中引发了热烈讨论，尤其是在Remake三部曲其他开发者此前发表类似言论之后。

paragraphs.en: Hamaguchi made similar remarks in an August 1 interview with Automaton , confirming that the Remake series is a “new, overarching universe that encompasses the lore of the many various spin-offs” in the FF7 universe — “not just Advent Children, but also Dirge of Cerberus and Crisis Core.”
paragraphs.cn: 滨口在8月1日接受Automaton采访时也发表了类似说法，确认Remake系列是「一个涵盖FF7宇宙众多外传设定的全新、宏大的宇宙」——「不只有《Advent Children》，还有Dirge of Cerberus和Crisis Core。」

paragraphs.en: “We’re not denying the possibility of the ending tying into FFVII AC, but rather, we’re saying that FFVII AC has just been incorporated into the overarching FFVII remake series, including the ending. However, I won’t comment on whether the ending is positioned to lead into it,” he told the outlet.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们并不否认结局与FFVII AC产生联系的可能性；相反，我们是在说，FFVII AC已经被纳入涵盖结局在内的整个FFVII重制系列。不过，我不会评论结局是否被安排为通向它的桥梁。」他告诉该媒体。

paragraphs.en: "[But] to make sure it doesn't become stale and people know exactly where it's going, [that it] doesn't just follow the original word for word, we add in extra elements which add that little bit of doubt. Getting the right balance of that is so key. Ultimately, we're not trying to change the Final Fantasy 7 story into something really different. The overall balance wouldn't really allow for that anyway."
paragraphs.cn: 「但为了避免作品变得陈旧、让人们一眼就知道故事将走向何方，我们加入了额外元素，为剧情增添一丝不确定性。掌握好这种平衡至关重要。归根结底，我们并不是要把Final Fantasy 7的故事改成完全不同的东西；整体平衡本来也不允许我们这么做。」

paragraphs.en: Hamaguchi’s latest comments have created stirred up a heated conversation within the fanbase, with some lamenting the trilogy’s shift away from the original game’s storyline in favor of a metaverse-style combo of all FF7 properties, while others remain cautiously optimistic about what this entails for the fates of Cloud, Tifa, Barret, and co.
paragraphs.cn: 滨口最新的评论在粉丝群体中掀起了热烈讨论：有人哀叹三部曲偏离原作剧情，转而采用将所有FF7作品组合起来的元宇宙式方案；另一些人则对Cloud、Tifa、Barret等人的命运持谨慎乐观态度。

paragraphs.en: In June, Hamaguchi spoke further about Revelation’s ending, saying that while players will be able to shape the story in some way, everyone will ultimately come to a "singular ending."
paragraphs.cn: 6月，滨口进一步谈到Revelation的结局，称玩家将能以某种方式塑造故事，但最终所有人都会走向一个「单一结局」。

paragraphs.en: "The idea is to kind of change the approach and the depth of these story moments for these characters in this final chapter," he said. "We hope players look forward to that moment in the game."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们的想法是，在这个最终篇章中，改变这些角色经历故事时刻的处理方式和深度。我们希望玩家期待游戏中的那个时刻。」他说。

paragraphs.en: Final Fantasy VII Revelation releases in spring 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store.
paragraphs.cn: Final Fantasy VII Revelation将于2027年春季在Nintendo Switch 2、PlayStation5（PS5）、XBOX Series X和S，以及通过Steam和Epic Games Store登陆PC。
